•ie, lack of Hib/S. pneumoniae vax or PE suggesting meningitis
: CBC, lytes, glucose, renal & liver funct, RPR
levetiracetam, phenytoin, valproic acid, carbamazepine, lamotrigine, phenobarbital, topiramate
•rarely develops into epilepsy – monitor if complex febrile sz (more likely to recur)
